0022600110.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-2) are on the road against the Denver Nuggets (0-1) in their third game of the season, and both teams are still looking for their first win. The Pelicans are 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, and 10th in the West, while Denver is 5th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, and 11th in the West. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, while Denver is without Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans lost all three meetings, most recently 122-116 in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
